## About

Insurance Support by Hari Kotian is an IRDAI-registered (Reg 0149161D) independent insurance advisory firm based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. We provide free and expert guidance on all types of insurance: health, life, motor, travel, home, and cyber insurance. Our blog covers claim rejection rights, appeal processes, policy comparisons, LIC guidance, tax benefits, and IRDAI regulations. We serve clients across India including Bengaluru, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, and tier 2 cities.

Hari Kotian has over 25 years of experience in the insurance industry and specializes in claim settlement assistance, policy advisory, and fighting claim rejections for Indian consumers.

## Expertise

- Health insurance claim rejection and appeal process
- LIC policy revival, surrender, and claim assistance
- Motor insurance (car and two-wheeler) claim guidance
- Term insurance vs endowment vs ULIP comparisons
- Section 80C and 80D tax benefits on insurance premiums
- IRDAI grievance and ombudsman complaint filing
- Insurance portability and pre-existing disease rules
- Senior citizen health insurance plans
- Insurance for tier 2 and tier 3 Indian cities
